# TekiVex UI

> Quantum-class React component library — 78 production-grade components, WCAG 2.1 AAA, Quantum AI forms, zero-runtime TKX CSS engine, WAI-ARIA 1.2, full TypeScript, MIT license.

## Install

```
npm install tekivex-ui
```

## Quick start

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, TkxButton, quantumDark } from 'tekivex-ui';
import 'tekivex-ui/styles';

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={quantumDark}>
      <TkxButton variant="primary" onClick={() => {}}>Hello</TkxButton>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Subpackage imports

- `tekivex-ui`           — all components + ThemeProvider
- `tekivex-ui/styles`    — base CSS (import once at root)
- `tekivex-ui/themes`    — quantumDark, auroraLight, generatePalette
- `tekivex-ui/charts`    — TkxCharts (area, bar, line, pie, donut, scatter, radar)
- `tekivex-ui/headless`  — unstyled hooks (useTabs, useModal, useToast…)
- `tekivex-ui/i18n`      — I18nProvider, 27 locale strings
- `tekivex-ui/quantum`   — TkxQuantumForm, QuantumEngine
- `tekivex-ui/realtime`  — TkxLiveFeed, TkxLiveMetrics, TkxRealTimeChart, TkxLiveLog

## ThemeProvider (required root wrapper)

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, quantumDark, auroraLight } from 'tekivex-ui';
// Wrap your app once:
<ThemeProvider theme={quantumDark}>{children}</ThemeProvider>
// Or light:
<ThemeProvider theme={auroraLight}>{children}</ThemeProvider>
```

## RSC (React Server Components) compatibility

Components marked ✅ are RSC-safe (no hooks, no browser APIs, pure render).
Components marked 🖥 require "use client" — they use useState/useEffect/browser APIs.

### RSC-safe (render in Server Components without "use client")
- TkxBadge ✅
- TkxButton ✅
- TkxCard ✅
- TkxDivider ✅
- TkxEmpty ✅
- TkxIcon ✅
- TkxInput ✅ (uncontrolled; controlled usage needs "use client")
- TkxList ✅
- TkxProgress ✅
- TkxResult ✅
- TkxSkeleton ✅
- TkxStepper ✅ (display mode; interactive mode needs "use client")
- TkxToggle ✅ (uncontrolled; controlled usage needs "use client")

### Requires "use client"
- TkxAccordion 🖥  TkxAffix 🖥  TkxAlert 🖥  TkxAnchor 🖥  TkxAppBar 🖥
- TkxAutocomplete 🖥  TkxAvatar 🖥  TkxBottomNav 🖥  TkxBreadcrumb 🖥
- TkxCarousel 🖥  TkxCascader 🖥  TkxChat 🖥  TkxCheckbox 🖥
- TkxClock 🖥  TkxColorPicker 🖥  TkxCommand 🖥  TkxConfigProvider 🖥
- TkxDataGrid 🖥  TkxDatePicker 🖥  TkxDrawer 🖥  TkxDropdown 🖥
- TkxFileUpload 🖥  TkxForm 🖥  TkxImage 🖥  TkxLayout 🖥
- TkxLiveFeed 🖥  TkxLiveLog 🖥  TkxLiveMetrics 🖥
- TkxMasonry 🖥  TkxMentions 🖥  TkxMenu 🖥  TkxModal 🖥
- TkxNumberInput 🖥  TkxOTP 🖥  TkxPagination 🖥  TkxPlayground 🖥
- TkxPopover 🖥  TkxQRCode 🖥  TkxQuantumForm 🖥  TkxRadio 🖥
- TkxRating 🖥  TkxRealTimeChart 🖥  TkxRichTextDisplay 🖥
- TkxSegmented 🖥  TkxSelect 🖥  TkxSlider 🖥  TkxSnackbar 🖥
- TkxSpeedDial 🖥  TkxSpin 🖥  TkxStatistic 🖥  TkxTable 🖥
- TkxTabs 🖥  TkxTag 🖥  TkxThemeBuilder 🖥  TkxTimeline 🖥
- TkxToast 🖥  TkxToolbar 🖥  TkxTooltip 🖥  TkxTour 🖥
- TkxTransferList 🖥  TkxTreeView 🖥  TkxTypography 🖥
- TkxVideoPlayer 🖥  TkxWatermark 🖥

### Next.js / RSC usage pattern

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx (Server Component — wraps everything)
import { TkxBadge, TkxButton } from 'tekivex-ui'; // ✅ RSC-safe

// app/components/MyForm.tsx
'use client'; // required for interactive components
import { TkxInput, TkxSelect, TkxModal } from 'tekivex-ui';
```

## Components A–Z

### TkxAccordion
Interactive expand/collapse sections.
```tsx
import { TkxAccordion } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAccordion
  items={[{ key: '1', label: 'Title', content: <p>Body</p> }]}
  defaultOpen={['1']}
  multiple   // allow multiple open at once
/>
```

### TkxAffix
Sticks element to viewport edge on scroll.
```tsx
import { TkxAffix } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAffix offsetTop={64}><TkxButton>Sticky</TkxButton></TkxAffix>
```

### TkxAlert
Status / feedback banners.
```tsx
import { TkxAlert } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAlert type="success" message="Saved!" description="Your changes have been saved." closable />
<TkxAlert type="error"   message="Failed" />
<TkxAlert type="warning" message="Low disk space" />
<TkxAlert type="info"    message="New version available" />
```

### TkxAnchor
In-page navigation with scroll spy.
```tsx
import { TkxAnchor } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAnchor items={[{ href: '#section-1', title: 'Section 1' }, { href: '#section-2', title: 'Section 2' }]} />
```

### TkxAppBar
Top navigation bar.
```tsx
import { TkxAppBar } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAppBar title="My App" logo={<Logo />} actions={[<TkxButton>Login</TkxButton>]} />
```

### TkxAutocomplete
Text input with suggestion dropdown.
```tsx
import { TkxAutocomplete } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAutocomplete
  options={[{ value: 'react', label: 'React' }, { value: 'vue', label: 'Vue' }]}
  placeholder="Search frameworks…"
  onSelect={(val) => console.log(val)}
/>
```

### TkxAvatar
User / entity avatars with fallback initials.
```tsx
import { TkxAvatar } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxAvatar src="/user.jpg" alt="Jane" size={48} />
<TkxAvatar name="Jane Doe" size={48} />          // initials fallback
<TkxAvatar icon="user" size={32} />              // icon fallback
```

### TkxBadge ✅ (RSC-safe)
Status dot / count indicator.
```tsx
import { TkxBadge } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxBadge count={5}><TkxButton>Inbox</TkxButton></TkxBadge>
<TkxBadge dot><TkxAvatar name="A" /></TkxBadge>
<TkxBadge count={0} showZero />
```

### TkxBottomNav
Mobile-first bottom navigation bar.
```tsx
import { TkxBottomNav } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxBottomNav
  items={[{ label: 'Home', icon: '🏠', value: 'home' }, { label: 'Search', icon: '🔍', value: 'search' }]}
  value="home"
  onChange={(v) => setTab(v)}
/>
```

### TkxBreadcrumb
Path navigation.
```tsx
import { TkxBreadcrumb } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxBreadcrumb items={[{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Products', href: '/products' }, { label: 'Item' }]} />
```

### TkxButton ✅ (RSC-safe)
Primary interactive button.
```tsx
import { TkxButton } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxButton variant="primary" size="md" onClick={fn}>Save</TkxButton>
<TkxButton variant="secondary">Cancel</TkxButton>
<TkxButton variant="ghost">Learn more</TkxButton>
<TkxButton variant="danger">Delete</TkxButton>
<TkxButton loading>Saving…</TkxButton>
<TkxButton disabled>Disabled</TkxButton>
<TkxButton leftIcon={<Icon />}>With icon</TkxButton>
```
Props: `variant` ("primary"|"secondary"|"ghost"|"danger"|"outline"), `size` ("xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"|"xl"), `loading`, `disabled`, `leftIcon`, `rightIcon`, `fullWidth`.

### TkxCard ✅ (RSC-safe)
Content container with optional header/footer.
```tsx
import { TkxCard } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxCard title="Card Title" extra={<TkxButton size="sm">Edit</TkxButton>}>
  Card body content
</TkxCard>
```

### TkxCarousel
Image / content slider.
```tsx
import { TkxCarousel } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxCarousel autoPlay interval={3000} dots arrows>
  <div>Slide 1</div>
  <div>Slide 2</div>
</TkxCarousel>
```

### TkxCascader
Multi-level select (region/category picker).
```tsx
import { TkxCascader } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxCascader
  options={[{ value: 'us', label: 'US', children: [{ value: 'ca', label: 'California' }] }]}
  onChange={(path) => console.log(path)}
/>
```

### TkxChat
Real-time chat UI (bubbles, timestamps, avatars).
```tsx
import { TkxChat } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxChat
  messages={[{ id: '1', text: 'Hello', sender: 'user', timestamp: Date.now() }]}
  onSend={(text) => sendMessage(text)}
/>
```

### TkxCheckbox
Accessible checkbox with indeterminate state.
```tsx
import { TkxCheckbox } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxCheckbox label="Accept terms" checked={val} onChange={setVal} />
<TkxCheckbox label="Select all" indeterminate />
```

### TkxClock
Analog/digital clock display.
```tsx
import { TkxClock } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxClock variant="analog" size={200} />
<TkxClock variant="digital" />
```

### TkxColorPicker
HSL/HEX/RGB color selection.
```tsx
import { TkxColorPicker } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxColorPicker value="#00f5d4" onChange={(hex) => setColor(hex)} />
```

### TkxCommand
⌘K command palette / search.
```tsx
import { TkxCommand } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxCommand
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  items={[{ id: 'home', label: 'Go Home', action: () => navigate('/') }]}
/>
```

### TkxDataGrid
High-performance data grid with virtual scrolling, sorting, filtering, pagination.
```tsx
import { TkxDataGrid } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxDataGrid
  columns={[{ field: 'name', headerName: 'Name', width: 200 }, { field: 'age', headerName: 'Age', width: 100 }]}
  rows={[{ id: 1, name: 'Alice', age: 30 }]}
  pagination
  pageSize={25}
  sortable
  filterable
/>
```

### TkxDatePicker
Calendar + time picker.
```tsx
import { TkxDatePicker } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxDatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} format="MM/DD/YYYY" />
<TkxDatePicker range />   // date range picker
```

### TkxDivider ✅ (RSC-safe)
Horizontal or vertical separator.
```tsx
import { TkxDivider } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxDivider />
<TkxDivider orientation="vertical" />
<TkxDivider label="OR" />
```

### TkxDrawer
Side panel / off-canvas drawer.
```tsx
import { TkxDrawer } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxDrawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} placement="right" title="Settings">
  Content here
</TkxDrawer>
```

### TkxDropdown
Trigger + dropdown menu.
```tsx
import { TkxDropdown } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxDropdown items={[{ label: 'Edit', onClick: fn }, { label: 'Delete', danger: true, onClick: fn }]}>
  <TkxButton>Actions ▾</TkxButton>
</TkxDropdown>
```

### TkxEmpty ✅ (RSC-safe)
Empty state illustration + message.
```tsx
import { TkxEmpty } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxEmpty description="No results found" />
<TkxEmpty image="search" description="Try a different query" action={<TkxButton>Reset</TkxButton>} />
```

### TkxFileUpload
Drag & drop file upload zone.
```tsx
import { TkxFileUpload } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxFileUpload accept=".pdf,.docx" multiple maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024} onUpload={(files) => upload(files)} />
```

### TkxForm
Form with built-in validation, field-level errors, and submit handling.
```tsx
import { TkxForm, TkxFormField, TkxInput } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxForm onSubmit={(values) => console.log(values)}>
  <TkxFormField name="email" rules={[{ required: true }, { type: 'email' }]}>
    <TkxInput label="Email" type="email" />
  </TkxFormField>
  <TkxButton type="submit">Submit</TkxButton>
</TkxForm>
```

### TkxIcon ✅ (RSC-safe)
SVG icon system (100+ icons).
```tsx
import { TkxIcon } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxIcon name="check" size={20} color="#00f5d4" />
<TkxIcon name="alert-circle" size={16} />
```

### TkxImage
Image with lazy loading, blur placeholder, fallback.
```tsx
import { TkxImage } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxImage src="/photo.jpg" alt="Photo" width={400} height={300} lazy blurPlaceholder />
```

### TkxInput ✅ (RSC-safe for uncontrolled)
Text input with floating label, prefix/suffix, validation states.
```tsx
import { TkxInput } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxInput label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
<TkxInput label="Search" prefix={<TkxIcon name="search" />} />
<TkxInput label="Amount" suffix="USD" type="number" />
<TkxInput label="Password" type="password" showPasswordToggle />
<TkxInput error="Required" />
```

### TkxLayout
Responsive grid/flex layout primitives.
```tsx
import { TkxLayout, TkxRow, TkxCol } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxRow gutter={16}>
  <TkxCol span={12}>Left</TkxCol>
  <TkxCol span={12}>Right</TkxCol>
</TkxRow>
```

### TkxLiveFeed (Real-Time)
Streaming event feed (WebSocket / SSE).
```tsx
import { TkxLiveFeed } from 'tekivex-ui/realtime';
<TkxLiveFeed url="wss://api.example.com/feed" maxItems={50} />
```

### TkxLiveMetrics (Real-Time)
Live dashboard metrics with sparklines.
```tsx
import { TkxLiveMetrics } from 'tekivex-ui/realtime';
<TkxLiveMetrics metrics={[{ label: 'RPS', value: 1240, trend: 'up' }]} refreshMs={1000} />
```

### TkxLiveLog (Real-Time)
Streaming log viewer (ANSI color support).
```tsx
import { TkxLiveLog } from 'tekivex-ui/realtime';
<TkxLiveLog url="wss://api.example.com/logs" maxLines={500} />
```

### TkxMasonry
Pinterest-style masonry grid layout.
```tsx
import { TkxMasonry } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxMasonry columns={3} gap={16}>
  {items.map(item => <TkxCard key={item.id}>{item.content}</TkxCard>)}
</TkxMasonry>
```

### TkxMenu
Vertical navigation menu with nested submenus.
```tsx
import { TkxMenu } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxMenu
  items={[
    { key: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: '🏠' },
    { key: 'products', label: 'Products', children: [{ key: 'list', label: 'All Products' }] },
  ]}
  selectedKey="home"
  onSelect={(key) => navigate(key)}
/>
```

### TkxModal
Accessible dialog / modal overlay.
```tsx
import { TkxModal } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxModal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Confirm Delete" footer={
  <><TkxButton onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</TkxButton>
    <TkxButton variant="danger" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</TkxButton></>
}>
  Are you sure you want to delete this item?
</TkxModal>
```

### TkxNumberInput
Numeric input with increment/decrement controls.
```tsx
import { TkxNumberInput } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxNumberInput label="Quantity" min={1} max={99} step={1} value={qty} onChange={setQty} />
```

### TkxOTP
One-time password / PIN input.
```tsx
import { TkxOTP } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxOTP length={6} onComplete={(code) => verify(code)} />
```

### TkxPagination
Page navigation.
```tsx
import { TkxPagination } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxPagination total={200} pageSize={20} current={page} onChange={setPage} showSizeChanger />
```

### TkxPopover
Floating content on hover/click.
```tsx
import { TkxPopover } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxPopover content={<div>Details here</div>} title="Info" trigger="hover">
  <TkxButton>Hover me</TkxButton>
</TkxPopover>
```

### TkxProgress ✅ (RSC-safe)
Linear or circular progress bar.
```tsx
import { TkxProgress } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxProgress value={75} />
<TkxProgress value={75} variant="circular" showLabel />
<TkxProgress value={75} colorScheme="success" />
```
Props: `value` (0-100), `variant` ("linear"|"circular"), `colorScheme` ("default"|"success"|"warning"|"danger"), `showLabel`, `size` ("sm"|"md"|"lg").

### TkxQuantumForm
AI-powered form — infers field types, validation, labels from field names.
```tsx
import { TkxQuantumForm } from 'tekivex-ui/quantum';
// Minimal — AI infers everything:
<TkxQuantumForm fields={['email', 'password', 'phone', 'confirm_password']} onSubmit={handleSubmit} />
// With explicit overrides:
<TkxQuantumForm
  fields={[{ name: 'email' }, { name: 'budget', type: 'number', label: 'Monthly Budget' }]}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  showConfidence   // shows AI confidence score per field
/>
```

### TkxRadio
Radio button group.
```tsx
import { TkxRadio, TkxRadioGroup } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxRadioGroup value={val} onChange={setVal}>
  <TkxRadio value="a" label="Option A" />
  <TkxRadio value="b" label="Option B" />
</TkxRadioGroup>
```

### TkxRating
Star / emoji rating input.
```tsx
import { TkxRating } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxRating value={3.5} max={5} onChange={setRating} allowHalf />
```

### TkxRealTimeChart (Real-Time)
Live-updating charts.
```tsx
import { TkxRealTimeChart } from 'tekivex-ui/realtime';
<TkxRealTimeChart type="area" dataKey="rps" url="wss://api.example.com/metrics" windowMs={30000} />
```

### TkxResult ✅ (RSC-safe)
Success / error / info result page.
```tsx
import { TkxResult } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxResult status="success" title="Payment successful" subTitle="Order #1234" extra={<TkxButton>Continue</TkxButton>} />
<TkxResult status="error" title="Submission failed" />
```

### TkxSelect
Dropdown select with search and multi-select.
```tsx
import { TkxSelect } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSelect label="Country" options={[{ value: 'us', label: 'United States' }]} onChange={setVal} />
<TkxSelect label="Tags" multiple options={tags} />
```

### TkxSegmented
Segmented control (button group toggle).
```tsx
import { TkxSegmented } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSegmented options={['Day', 'Week', 'Month']} value={period} onChange={setPeriod} />
```

### TkxSkeleton ✅ (RSC-safe)
Loading placeholder shimmer.
```tsx
import { TkxSkeleton } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSkeleton width={200} height={20} />
<TkxSkeleton variant="avatar" size={48} />
<TkxSkeleton variant="card" />
```

### TkxSlider
Range/value slider input.
```tsx
import { TkxSlider } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSlider min={0} max={100} value={vol} onChange={setVol} marks />
<TkxSlider range defaultValue={[20, 80]} />
```

### TkxSnackbar
Non-blocking notification toast (bottom of screen).
```tsx
import { TkxSnackbar } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSnackbar open={open} message="File saved" onClose={() => setOpen(false)} autoHideDuration={3000} />
```

### TkxSpeedDial
FAB with radial action buttons.
```tsx
import { TkxSpeedDial } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSpeedDial actions={[{ icon: '✏️', label: 'Edit', onClick: fn }, { icon: '🗑', label: 'Delete', onClick: fn }]} />
```

### TkxSpin ✅ (RSC-safe via CSS animation)
Loading spinner.
```tsx
import { TkxSpin } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxSpin />
<TkxSpin size="lg" tip="Loading…" />
```

### TkxStepper ✅ (RSC-safe for display mode)
Multi-step progress indicator.
```tsx
import { TkxStepper } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxStepper
  steps={[{ title: 'Account' }, { title: 'Profile' }, { title: 'Review' }]}
  current={1}
/>
```

### TkxTable
Data table with sorting, pagination, row selection.
```tsx
import { TkxTable } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTable
  columns={[{ key: 'name', title: 'Name', sortable: true }, { key: 'status', title: 'Status' }]}
  dataSource={rows}
  rowSelection={{ type: 'checkbox', onChange: setSelected }}
  pagination={{ pageSize: 10 }}
/>
```

### TkxTabs
Tabbed panel navigation.
```tsx
import { TkxTabs } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTabs items={[{ key: 'overview', label: 'Overview', content: <p>…</p> }, { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', content: <p>…</p> }]} defaultActiveKey="overview" />
```

### TkxTag
Closable label / chip.
```tsx
import { TkxTag } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTag color="primary">React</TkxTag>
<TkxTag closable onClose={() => removeTag('react')}>TypeScript</TkxTag>
```

### TkxTimeline
Vertical event timeline.
```tsx
import { TkxTimeline } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTimeline items={[{ time: '09:00', title: 'Deploy', description: 'v2.5.11 released', color: 'success' }]} />
```

### TkxToast
Ephemeral notification (top-right).
```tsx
import { TkxToast } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxToast type="success" message="Saved!" duration={3000} />
```
Or programmatic:
```tsx
import { toast } from 'tekivex-ui';
toast.success('Saved!');
toast.error('Failed');
toast.info('New version available');
```

### TkxToggle ✅ (RSC-safe for uncontrolled)
On/off switch.
```tsx
import { TkxToggle } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxToggle label="Dark mode" checked={dark} onChange={setDark} />
```

### TkxToolbar
Horizontal action bar.
```tsx
import { TkxToolbar } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxToolbar items={[{ icon: '✂️', label: 'Cut', onClick: fn }, { icon: '📋', label: 'Paste', onClick: fn }]} />
```

### TkxTooltip
Hover tooltip.
```tsx
import { TkxTooltip } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTooltip content="Save changes (⌘S)" placement="top">
  <TkxButton>Save</TkxButton>
</TkxTooltip>
```

### TkxTour
Step-by-step feature walkthrough.
```tsx
import { TkxTour } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTour
  open={tourOpen}
  steps={[{ target: '#save-btn', title: 'Save', description: 'Click to save your work.' }]}
  onClose={() => setTourOpen(false)}
/>
```

### TkxTransferList
Dual list with move actions (permissions/assignment UI).
```tsx
import { TkxTransferList } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTransferList dataSource={allUsers} targetKeys={assignedIds} onChange={setAssigned} />
```

### TkxTreeView
Hierarchical tree with expand/collapse, checkboxes.
```tsx
import { TkxTreeView } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxTreeView
  data={[{ id: '1', label: 'Root', children: [{ id: '1-1', label: 'Child' }] }]}
  checkable
  onCheck={setChecked}
/>
```

### TkxTypography
Heading, paragraph, text, link primitives.
```tsx
import { TkxTypography } from 'tekivex-ui';
const { Title, Text, Paragraph, Link } = TkxTypography;
<Title level={1}>Heading 1</Title>
<Text type="secondary">Secondary text</Text>
<Paragraph ellipsis={{ rows: 2 }}>Long paragraph…</Paragraph>
<Link href="/docs">Docs →</Link>
```

### TkxVideoPlayer
HTML5 video player with custom controls.
```tsx
import { TkxVideoPlayer } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxVideoPlayer src="/video.mp4" poster="/thumb.jpg" controls captions={[{ src: '/en.vtt', lang: 'en' }]} />
```

### TkxWatermark
Repeating watermark overlay (text or image).
```tsx
import { TkxWatermark } from 'tekivex-ui';
<TkxWatermark content="CONFIDENTIAL" rotate={-30} gap={[100, 100]}>
  <YourContent />
</TkxWatermark>
```

## Theming

```tsx
import { generatePalette, ThemeProvider } from 'tekivex-ui/themes';

// Generate a WCAG-compliant palette from a single brand color
const myTheme = generatePalette('#6366f1'); // Indigo brand
<ThemeProvider theme={myTheme}>{children}</ThemeProvider>

// Built-in themes
import { quantumDark, auroraLight } from 'tekivex-ui';
```

Theme tokens: `bg`, `surface`, `surfaceAlt`, `border`, `text`, `textMuted`,
`primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`.

## Headless hooks (tekivex-ui/headless)

```tsx
import { useTabs, useModal, useToast, useDisclosure, useForm } from 'tekivex-ui/headless';

const { activeTab, setActiveTab } = useTabs({ defaultTab: 0 });
const { isOpen, open, close } = useDisclosure();
const { show } = useToast();
```

## i18n (tekivex-ui/i18n)

```tsx
import { I18nProvider, locales } from 'tekivex-ui/i18n';
<I18nProvider locale={locales.fr}>{children}</I18nProvider>
// 27 locales: en, fr, de, es, pt, it, nl, pl, ru, zh, ja, ko, ar, he, fa, tr, vi, th, id, ms, hi, bn, uk, cs, ro, hu, sv
```

## TypeScript types

```ts
import type {
  TkxButtonProps,
  TkxInputProps,
  TkxModalProps,
  TkxSelectProps,
  TkxTableProps,
  TkxDataGridProps,
  ThemeTokens,
} from 'tekivex-ui';
```
